caption: Two hands work a tuft of white fibrous material against a softly blurred tan backdrop. The left thumb and index finger pinch one edge while the right index and middle fingers grip the opposite side, drawing the loose, wispy strands inward. As the manipulation continues, the left hand shifts from a near-vertical pinch to a horizontal grip with its nails turned toward the camera, and the right hand rotates so its fingernails face outward instead of its knuckles. The fluffy mass contracts into a rounded white ball held between the fingertips of both hands, with stray fibers flicking from its edges. The ball drifts from the left side of the frame toward the center as the fingers adjust their hold. The hands keep pressing and shaping the fiber, the surface of the ball growing smoother while a few loose wisps remain at the margins. The segment closes with the consolidated tuft still cradled between the pinched fingertips, the working motion ongoing.
